resources.string: This separate test app observes only its own lifecycle callbacks. It has no permissions, storage or connection. The trace exists only in memory.

Choose org.liveabit.fixture in a fresh Local inspection session first. Tap Begin here, then wait about 30 seconds, either idle or switching screens several times. Tap Finish, return to the inspector and tap Inspect now. Return here for the finished comparison codes.

Enter these start/end time codes and the finished own resumed union into the inspector\u2019s controlled-test panel. Both totals use this same interior window; setup and return time are excluded.

This is ground truth only for our own instrumented callback window. It does not attest Android usage-history completeness, current attention, other apps, OAP summaries or production accuracy. No automatic pass threshold is assigned. Clear or process restart removes this measurement.
No callbacks retained inside this measurement window. Begin/Finish markers are separate from callback records.
